newsitem.title: USA: Duquesne Energy names David Marshall CEO.
newsitem.headline: Duquesne Energy names David Marshall CEO.

text.p: Duquesne Energy Inc said Tuesday its board of directors had elected David Marshall as chief executive officer and president of the energy services company.
The board also elected him chief executive officer of its subsidiary, Duquesne Light Co, it said.
Marshall has been president of the subsidiary since 1995 and serving as interim chief executive officer and president of the parent company since August 1996, it said.
He has been a director of the company and the subsidiary since 1995, it added.

"Following the resignation of Wesley von Schack in August 1996, to accept a position with another electric utility, the Board initiated a search for his successor, looking at internal and external candidates," it said. "That search was concluded today, with the election of Marshall."
